The rest has to come from the other domains: antenna, NFC, acoustics and structure. I'll OBJECT until the pool balances.

Thermal is at 43.0 °C with A_spr = 320 mm² (250 mm³), so I have no margin to cut. Any reduction breaks the skin limit. I can use a little caseback plane, but I don't need it yet. A thinner wall probably changes the conduction path, so I'm probing 1.1 mm wall at 320 and 360 mm² to see whether it costs me area. I'm also probing 280 mm² to get the slope. If 1.1 mm wall holds 43 °C at 320 mm², I support it, since it returns 150 mm³ to the pool. I OBJECT because the pool is still over by 984 mm³.

Structure can't take the thinner wall. My margin is 1.438 at 1.2 mm wall, 9 mm² port and 1800 mm³ of ribs, which is below the 1.5 requirement. At 1.1 mm it would be worse. That makes me an OBJECT on my own requirement, not just on the pool.

I'm probing three ways to get to 1.5:
- **More ribs:** 2000 mm³ at 1.2 mm wall. This adds 200 mm³ to the interior.
- **Thicker wall:** 1.3 mm with 1800 mm³ of ribs. This costs everyone 150 mm³.
- **Smaller port:** 7 mm² (read-only, for acoustics to weigh). It costs me no volume, but it hits acoustics.

I'll report the slopes next round. I'll also test whether a thicker wall lets me cut ribs by more than 150 mm³, which would give a net volume gain.

Acoustics: my siren fails. The driver needs 9.08 W against the 1.0 W cap, and resonance is 5581 Hz, which is too high and too lossy. That is a tuning problem, not a volume problem. I expect a longer outlet (h_out) and a thinner mesh to cut power without more volume, so I'm cutting r_mesh to the 20 rayl floor and lengthening h_out.

I can give back volume now. I'm claiming 1200 mm³, which frees 260, and probing 1000 mm³. Structure, I'm also probing port 7 mm² so you can see its cost to me. Please hold the port at 9 mm² until I report the slope.

Battery, siren endurance depends on siren power. Once I'm under 1 W, 3 h should not need extra battery volume.

Haptics can give back volume. Force scales roughly linearly with volume (1.069 N at 350 mm³, so about 0.00305 N per mm³). The 0.9 N floor is at about 295 mm³. I'm claiming 305 mm³, which should give about 0.93 N with a small margin, and frees 45 mm³. I'm probing 295 and 300 mm³ to confirm the floor, and 280 mm³ to confirm it fails. I won't go below 295 mm³. Haptics doesn't use the caseback plane, the perimeter or the port. I'll OBJECT until the pool balances: it is still about 680 mm³ over after my cut, and the larger cuts have to come from antenna, acoustics, board and structure.
